scenes.title: hook
scenes.narration: Every June, a wind from the sea turns half of India green. Here is how the monsoon actually starts.

scenes.title: beat 1
scenes.narration: Moist air travels off the Arabian Sea and meets the hot land.

scenes.title: beat 2
scenes.narration: The Western Ghats push that air upward, so the first heavy rain falls on the west coast.

scenes.title: beat 3
scenes.narration: The same wind then moves north and east, which is why Kerala sees rain before Delhi.

scenes.title: payoff
scenes.narration: So the monsoon is not one cloud. It is a seasonal wind, a mountain wall, and a calendar you can follow.
doubts: Confirm the payoff stays general and does not invent a date or a record.
